title.narrative: Local Partner Health Services - Ankole and Acholi Regions

description.narrative: (Uganda): This activity was awarded to the AIDS Support Organization (TASO) and supports a population of four million across twelve districts in Ankole and eight districts in Acholi. With FY 2022 TB funds, the Ankole and Acholi Region TB and HIV activity will prioritize the following areas: 1) screening and detection of all forms of TB in infants, children, and adults at facility and community levels; 2) early initiation and completion of anti-TB treatment for all patients diagnosed with all forms of TB; 3) ensuring strong community systems to strengthen the continuum of TB prevention, screening, diagnosis, care, and treatment; and 4) improving the quality of the multi-drug resistant TB program and TB/HIV collaborative activities through the implementation and scale-up of evidence-based community and facility interventions across the TB diagnostic, prevention, and treatment cascade.To ensure continuation of services during the COVID-19 pandemic, the activity in the Ankole and Acholi regions will integrate infection prevention and control to protect service providers and beneficiaries of TB services. LPHS Acholi and Ankole will fund activities to improve gender equality and empower women to access and use high quality health services. By working closely with community partners including Village Health Teams (VHT) in increasing health seeking behavior, the activity will mitigate service disruption as a result of climatic conditions.Health systems strengthening activities are jointly supported with PEPFAR (HIV) funds, and therefore, this activity is co-funded with HIV/PEPFAR funds for the HSS cross-cutting areas at subnational level..
